target.title: Fix Claude never-prompt Keychain cache bypass (#1991)
target.body:
## Summary
- When Claude prompt mode is stored as `never` (Avoid Keychain prompts), CodexBar no longer reads/writes/clears the `oauth.claude` Keychain cache during OAuth load, invalidation, or cache presence checks.
- Background refresh now falls back to memory cache and `~/.claude/.credentials.json` instead of repeatedly touching Keychain items that can surface macOS prompts.
- Also skip MCP-only Claude Keychain payload probes under `never`, and stop owner-resolution probes of `Claude Code-credentials` when the stored prompt mode is `never`.
- Adds focused regression tests in `ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStoreNeverPromptCacheTests`.

Fixes the bug reported in #1991 where periodic refresh could still trigger macOS Keychain UI even after choosing Avoid Keychain prompts. #1990 (manual-refresh pre-alert UX) is intentionally unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `swift test --filter 'ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStoreNeverPromptCacheTests|ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStoreTests|ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStorePromptPolicyTests'`
- [x] `make check`

No live macOS Keychain prompt validation from this PR (repo policy); happy to adjust if maintainer wants a different acceptance path.
